summary: Canonical production-attached offline integration proof for the complete landed M3 recording system.

entries.contract: One offline Swift system executes the actual rev-2 operation registry, store, recovery, control, production file readback and topology wire, screen geometry/follow adapter, multitrack coordinator, artifact custody, shared microphone adapter/session, and production snapshot/list/inspect and control-result projectors with injected non-native dependencies. It covers all fixed/followed track selections, exact pre-authority cardinality and settlement, mandatory-video precedence, fixed-mode rejection, immutable drift, accepted-update deadline re-arm, control boundaries and races, custody CAS/recovery and restart recovery, terminal-clean or retained-residual store faults including compound cleanup-save failure, exact request/result/failure schemas, and authored/generated recording-manifest equality.
entries.worth: This catches cross-owner defects that focused schema, static, compile, or separately isolated harnesses cannot prove, while remaining content-free and permissionless.
entries.guard: The wrapper exclusively creates and removes its exact private root. No repo binary, live service, native capture API authority, device, filesystem media, TCC, pixels, audio, or UI executes; emitted public requests, admissions, controls, follow results, successful and failed snapshots, events, custody results, and response envelopes validate against the exact checked-in schemas.
